name: attacca
description: Bring your Attacca long-term memory into Claude Code: what Attacca already knows is injected at session start and on each prompt.

attacca_url.title: Attacca URL
attacca_url.description: Base URL of your Attacca instance. Leave the default unless you run a self-hosted one (no trailing slash).

attacca_token.title: Attacca API key
attacca_token.description: An API key with the memory:read scope. Create one in Attacca under Settings -> API keys.

recall_on_prompt.title: Recall on every prompt
recall_on_prompt.description: Fetch and inject relevant memory before each prompt you send. Turn off to recall only at session start.

project_id.title: Project id (optional)
project_id.description: Attacca project this session belongs to. Reserved: the read surface accepts it and ignores it until project binding ships.

observe_enabled.title: Send session activity back to Attacca
observe_enabled.description: Off by default. When on (a later version), Claude Code session activity is written to Attacca memory.
